messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — planning to lift the `waitlist_safe_defaults` feature flag tonight at 02:00 UTC for a limited window (2h). Goal: let a small cohort bypass waitlist for perf/load validation. Need smoke owner + rollback plan. Who's available?

ajay: I can own smoke checks. Prefer staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m steps.

samir: 10% sounds good. Is this tenant-scoped? I want to exclude high-compute customers.

marta: Yes tenant-scoped. We'll enable only the `beta_waitlist` cohort IDs. List is in the deploy doc: https://goto.redwood/waitlist-lift (private).

kevin: Ops note: prefer doing the flip inside the low-traffic window starting 02:00 UTC. I can watch infra metrics + autoscale.

lia: I'll be oncall for application errors and immediate rollback if error rate >0.5% or p95 latency increases >200ms.

ajay: Smoke checklist I'm planning (short):
- run 5 synthetic requests hitting waitlist bypass
- verify tokens generated and storage writes succeed
- check latency (p95) <150ms
- error rate 0 for the first 5m, <0.5% overall
- run a small manual regression prompt set against model variant

marta: Nice. Rollback plan: flip `waitlist_safe_defaults` back to `on` (safe-defaults) via console CLI and invalidate prefix cache for affected tenants. Command:

```
# set flag off (safe-defaults)
redwood-ctl flag set waitlist_safe_defaults on --tenants beta_waitlist
cachectl invalidate --prefix waitlist:beta
```

marta: We'll keep a 30m cool-off between 10% -> 50% steps. If anything looks off, rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: flag-change job queued by @marta for 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z (job id: jb-98123). Automated rollback hook enabled.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor GCM and infra alerts. Ping me in thread if spike.

ajay: Can someone add the smoke run commands to the runbook? I'll attach results.

marta: Added to runbook and linked to thread. Small ask: keep console logs for 48h for post-mortem if needed.

kevin: One more — feature gating: ensure rate limit for bypassed traffic is the same as normal path. I will validate.

lia: ACK. I'll be available 01:50-03:30 UTC.

samir: I'll watch billing/cost anomalies; large model fallback shouldn't trigger for these cohorts but want to confirm quotas.

ajay: Cool. Plan stands: 02:00 UTC start, 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m pauses; smoke owner @ajay; rollback owner @marta; ops monitor @kevin; oncall @lia.

marta: Perfect. If no objections, I'll press the queue at 01:55 UTC and post a short status update after each stage. :thumbsup:

lia: :thumbsup:
